note: M29 (D-066): definition of the PRIVATE installer payload that tools/r3hd_stage.py builds. The payload is a prebuilt application for the user-supplied-data model (D-065): the runtime binaries of the current verified build (r3hd.exe, rexruntime.dll, rexgpu-xenos.dll and, since M46, the LGPL DLLs ffmpeg.dll / mspack.dll), the installer engine and launcher, the configs they read, and a private Python runtime; D-203 includes the nine visually accepted native PS3 glyph PNGs plus an own manifest as exact binary resources; the unchanged payload audit and R-01 gates still apply; never full game data, saves, captures, debug symbols or test executables. It contains translated game code and a runtime with the public XEX keys compiled in: it is NOT publishable until the gates of D-065 / D-066 are met. Text files are copied with LF line endings so the payload does not depend on the checkout's core.autocrlf. G6-P31 (D-287): the constrained intro_20 level editor (app/tools/r3hd_level_editor*.py) and the Tk runtime of the same pinned CPython build (config/release/python_tk.json) are part of the payload. G6-P39 (D-295): the 3D Level Remix Editor (app/tools/r3hd_scene_view.py, r3hd_scene_gl.py, r3hd_level_scene.py) and its narrow OpenGL bridge app/python/_r3hd_scene_gl.pyd ("scene_gl": this project's own extension, built reproducibly from tools/scene_gl and pinned by hash) are part of the payload; the runtime still has no ctypes / _ctypes / libffi.
lgpl_source: M46 (D-084): r3hd_stage.py build writes r3hd-lgpl-source-<version>.zip (tools/m46_lgpl.py) beside payload/; it is distributed with the installer, from the same place

launcher.note: M30 (D-067): the Settings launcher and direct Play entry, built by tools/launcher/build_launcher.bat from tools/launcher only (static C runtime, no PDB, /Brepro). It holds no setting of its own: it shows r3hd_installer.py launcher-model and saves through set-preset.

scene_gl.note: G6-P39 (D-295): the 3D editor's narrow OpenGL bridge, built by tools\scene_gl\build_scene_gl.bat from tools/scene_gl/r3hd_scene_gl.cpp alone against the pinned CPython 3.11.4 (python311.dll import; static C runtime, no PDB, /Brepro, Control Flow Guard). Its interface has no pointer, DLL name, function name or callback; every buffer is checked and copied. Staged only when it equals sha256.

licenses.from: the pinned SDK checkout (external/rexglue-sdk at config/build/toolchain.json)

python.source: the python.org Windows x64 installation of CPython 3.11.4 (PSF License; LICENSE.txt is shipped beside it)
python.no_extension_modules: the extension modules are _tkinter.pyd (G6-P31, D-287: the level editor's Tk, pinned in config/release/python_tk.json) and _r3hd_scene_gl.pyd (G6-P39, D-295: the 3D editor's narrow OpenGL bridge, pinned in scene_gl; no general native-call interface); the runtime still has no _socket / _ssl / _ctypes / libffi, so neither the installer engine nor the editors can open a network connection or call an arbitrary DLL
